dedupe_keys.name: acoustic based data acquisition for leak detection of water distribution networks

description: Acoustic signals were collected at about 90 Hong Kong leak sites over one year using noise loggers, hydrophones and MEMS accelerometers. Repaired sites supplied the no-leak recordings. This resource is provided by Ibrahim A TIJANI. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Metal and non-metal pipes are represented, but the sample is tied to reported leaks and subsequent repairs. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
